meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在临时工作区里复现 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的具体缺陷:先写失败的回归测试,再做最小修复并验证,最后交付修复补丁。
howto.when: 当你要求修一个 bug、提交 bug 修复、为 bug 开 PR,或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一个 LazyCodex 的 bug,先复现再给补丁
say.note: 在临时工作区复现并验证后交付

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 能修吗?请开个 PR
say.note: 上游缺陷会从 fork 提交 PR

say.text: 把 LazyCodex 的修复作为 issue 提交,附上 diff
say.note: 该仓库只开 issue,不推分支

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex bug in a fresh temp workspace: reproduces it, adds a failing regression test, applies the smallest fix, verifies it, and delivers a fork PR or a verified-fix issue with the patch.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix a LazyCodex bug for me — reproduce it first, then give me the patch
say_en.note: Reproduces and verifies in a temp workspace

say_en.text: Can you fix this Codex CLI bug and open a PR?
say_en.note: Upstream defects become a fork PR

say_en.text: File the LazyCodex fix as an issue with the diff embedded
say_en.note: That repo gets issues, never PRs
